```{r}
##Non-linear transformations

# Set threshold at 75th percentile
threshold <- quantile(thyroid_data$TSH_Level, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create high TSH variable
thyroid_data$High_TSH <- ifelse(thyroid_data$TSH_Level > threshold, 1, 0)

# Set threshold at 75th percentile
threshold_3 <- quantile(thyroid_data$T3_Level, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create high TSH variable
thyroid_data$High_T3 <- ifelse(thyroid_data$T3_Level > threshold_3, 1, 0)


# Set threshold at 75th percentile
threshold_4 <- quantile(thyroid_data$T4_Level, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create high TSH variable
thyroid_data$High_T4 <- ifelse(thyroid_data$T4_Level > threshold_4, 1, 0)


# Set threshold at 75th percentile
threshold_N <- quantile(thyroid_data$Nodule_Size, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

# Create high TSH variable
thyroid_data$Large_Nodule <- ifelse(thyroid_data$Nodule_Size > threshold_N, 1, 0)



##GLM model

model3 <- glm(Diagnosis_Binary ~ Smoking + Obesity + Radiation_Exposure +
              Iodine_Deficiency + Diabetes + Gender + Family_History +
              Age_Group + High_TSH + High_T3 + High_T4 + Large_Nodule,
              data = thyroid_data, family = "binomial")


summary(model3)

```

```{r}
library(caret)

# Split data into training (80%) and testing (20%)
set.seed(123)

trainIndex <- createDataPartition(thyroid_data$Diagnosis_Binary, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
trainData <- thyroid_data[trainIndex, ]
testData <- thyroid_data[-trainIndex, ]

# Train model on training data
model_final <- glm(Diagnosis_Binary ~ Smoking + Obesity + Radiation_Exposure +
                   Iodine_Deficiency + Diabetes + Gender + Family_History +
                   Age_Group + High_TSH + High_T3 + High_T4 + Large_Nodule,
                   data = trainData, family = "binomial")
summary(model_final)
```

```{r}
# Predict on test data
testData$pred_prob <- predict(model_final, newdata = testData, type = "response")
testData$pred_class <- ifelse(testData$pred_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)

# Confusion Matrix

confusionMatrix(as.factor(testData$pred_class), as.factor(testData$Diagnosis_Binary))
```

```{r}
library(randomForest)

set.seed(123)

# Convert the target to factor for classification
trainData$Diagnosis_Binary <- as.factor(trainData$Diagnosis_Binary)
testData$Diagnosis_Binary <- as.factor(testData$Diagnosis_Binary)

# Train random forest model
rf_model <- randomForest(Diagnosis_Binary ~ Smoking + Obesity + Radiation_Exposure +
                         Iodine_Deficiency + Diabetes + Gender + Family_History +
                         Age_Group + High_TSH + High_T3 + High_T4 + Large_Nodule,
                         data = trainData,
                         ntree = 500, 
                         mtry = 4, 
                         importance = TRUE)

# Predict on test set
rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = testData)

# Confusion matrix
confusionMatrix(rf_pred, testData$Diagnosis_Binary)

# Variable importance
varImpPlot(rf_model)

```

```{r}
# Example for multi-class (adapt to your data)
low_data <- thyroid_data[thyroid_data$Thyroid_Cancer_Risk == "Low", ]
medium_data <- thyroid_data[thyroid_data$Thyroid_Cancer_Risk == "Medium", ]
high_data <- thyroid_data[thyroid_data$Thyroid_Cancer_Risk == "High", ]

##checking the Diagnosis_binary

sum(is.na(thyroid_data$Diagnosis_Binary))

########################################################3
# Separate data by Diagnosis_Binary
benign_data <- thyroid_data[thyroid_data$Diagnosis_Binary == 0, ]
malignant_data <- thyroid_data[thyroid_data$Diagnosis_Binary == 1, ]

# Determine the smaller class size
min_binary_size <- min(nrow(benign_data), nrow(malignant_data))

# Undersample the majority class
if (nrow(benign_data) > nrow(malignant_data)) {
  undersampled_benign <- benign_data[sample(nrow(benign_data), min_binary_size, replace = FALSE), ]
  balanced_data_binary <- rbind(undersampled_benign, malignant_data)
} else if (nrow(malignant_data) > nrow(benign_data)) {
  undersampled_malignant <- malignant_data[sample(nrow(malignant_data), min_binary_size, replace = FALSE), ]
  balanced_data_binary <- rbind(benign_data, undersampled_malignant)
} else {
  # Classes are already balanced
  balanced_data_binary <- rbind(benign_data, malignant_data)
}

# Removing the Patient ID
balanced_data_binary <- balanced_data_binary[, !names(balanced_data_binary) %in% "Patient_ID"]

# Display the balance
print("Balance of Diagnosis_Binary in balanced_data_binary:")
print(table(balanced_data_binary$Diagnosis_Binary))
```

```{r}
# Extract all hypothesis test results for Tableau
hypothesis_results <- data.frame(
  Test_Type = character(),
  Variable = character(),
  Test_Statistic = numeric(),
  P_Value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add Chi-square tests
chi_vars <- c("Smoking", "Radiation_Exposure", "Iodine_Deficiency", 
              "Obesity", "Diabetes", "Family_History", "Gender")

for (var in chi_vars) {
  test <- chisq.test(thyroid_data[[var]], thyroid_data$Diagnosis)
  hypothesis_results <- rbind(hypothesis_results, data.frame(
    Test_Type = "Chi-Square",
    Variable = var,
    Test_Statistic = test$statistic,
    P_Value = test$p.value
  ))
}

# Add t-tests for numerical variables
num_vars <- c("TSH_Level", "T3_Level", "T4_Level", "Nodule_Size")

for (var in num_vars) {
  benign_data <- thyroid_data[[var]][thyroid_data$Diagnosis == "Benign"]
  malignant_data <- thyroid_data[[var]][thyroid_data$Diagnosis == "Malignant"]
  test <- t.test(benign_data, malignant_data)
  hypothesis_results <- rbind(hypothesis_results, data.frame(
    Test_Type = "T-Test",
    Variable = var,
    Test_Statistic = test$statistic,
    P_Value = test$p.value
  ))
}

write.csv(hypothesis_results, "hypothesis_test_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Extract coefficients from all logistic regression models
extract_logistic_coefficients <- function(model, model_name) {
  if (!is.null(model)) {
    coeff_summary <- summary(model)$coefficients
    coeff_df <- data.frame(
      Model = model_name,
      Variable = rownames(coeff_summary),
      Coefficient = coeff_summary[, 1],
      Std_Error = coeff_summary[, 2],
      Z_Value = coeff_summary[, 3],
      P_Value = coeff_summary[, 4],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    return(coeff_df)
  }
}

# Apply to all your models
all_coeffs <- rbind(
  extract_logistic_coefficients(model, "Binary_Logistic"),
  extract_logistic_coefficients(model2, "With_Numerical"),
  extract_logistic_coefficients(model3, "With_Binary_Transform"),
  extract_logistic_coefficients(model_final, "Final_Model")
)

write.csv(all_coeffs, "logistic_regression_coefficients.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Create a comprehensive confusion matrix dataset
confusion_matrix_data <- data.frame(
  Model_Type = character(),
  Data_Type = character(),
  Phase = character(),
  Actual = character(),
  Predicted = character(),
  Count = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 1. Extract from your FINAL LOGISTIC MODEL (Model 4 - Testing)
if(exists("cm_test")) {
  cm_df <- as.data.frame(cm_test$table)
  colnames(cm_df) <- c("Predicted", "Actual", "Count")
  cm_df$Model_Type <- "Logistic_Regression"
  cm_df$Data_Type <- "Testing"
  cm_df$Phase <- "Final_Model"
  confusion_matrix_data <- rbind(confusion_matrix_data, cm_df)
}

# 2. Extract from RANDOM FOREST (Imbalanced)
if(exists("cm_rf")) {
  cm_rf_df <- as.data.frame(cm_rf$table)
  colnames(cm_rf_df) <- c("Predicted", "Actual", "Count")
  cm_rf_df$Model_Type <- "Random_Forest"
  cm_rf_df$Data_Type <- "Testing"
  cm_rf_df$Phase <- "Imbalanced"
  confusion_matrix_data <- rbind(confusion_matrix_data, cm_rf_df)
}

# 3. Extract from BALANCED DATA MODELS
# Balanced Logistic Regression
if(exists("conf_matrix_bal")) {
  cm_bal_log_df <- as.data.frame(conf_matrix_bal)
  colnames(cm_bal_log_df) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Count")
  cm_bal_log_df$Model_Type <- "Logistic_Regression"
  cm_bal_log_df$Data_Type <- "Testing"
  cm_bal_log_df$Phase <- "Balanced"
  confusion_matrix_data <- rbind(confusion_matrix_data, cm_bal_log_df)
}

# Balanced Random Forest
if(exists("conf_matrix_rf_bal")) {
  cm_bal_rf_df <- as.data.frame(conf_matrix_rf_bal)
  colnames(cm_bal_rf_df) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Count")
  cm_bal_rf_df$Model_Type <- "Random_Forest"
  cm_bal_rf_df$Data_Type <- "Testing"
  cm_bal_rf_df$Phase <- "Balanced"
  confusion_matrix_data <- rbind(confusion_matrix_data, cm_bal_rf_df)
}

# 4. Extract from MULTINOMIAL MODELS (Risk Levels)
if(exists("conf_matrix_multi")) {
  cm_multi_df <- as.data.frame(conf_matrix_multi)
  colnames(cm_multi_df) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Count")
  cm_multi_df$Model_Type <- "Multinomial_Logistic"
  cm_multi_df$Data_Type <- "Testing"
  cm_multi_df$Phase <- "Risk_Levels"
  confusion_matrix_data <- rbind(confusion_matrix_data, cm_multi_df)
}

# 5. If you have training confusion matrices, add them too
if(exists("cm_train")) {
  cm_train_df <- as.data.frame(cm_train$table)
  colnames(cm_train_df) <- c("Predicted", "Actual", "Count")
  cm_train_df$Model_Type <- "Logistic_Regression"
  cm_train_df$Data_Type <- "Training"
  cm_train_df$Phase <- "Final_Model"
  confusion_matrix_data <- rbind(confusion_matrix_data, cm_train_df)
}

# Export the comprehensive dataset
write.csv(confusion_matrix_data, "all_confusion_matrices.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
